'''Mechanical flaps''',<ref name="GFT" /> also known as '''merchnical control flaps'''<ref name="SWS" /> were part of an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder's]] design. They assisted with maneuverability,<ref name="GFT" /> as well as the airspeeder's ability to brake and change direction. The aerodynamic design of the flaps allowed the vehicle to make turns without reducing speed, making their course impossible for [[flight-predictor sensor]]s to track.<ref name="SWS" />
